description: Downloads and refreshes local MaxMind GeoLite2/GeoIP2 .mmdb database files, skipping unchanged builds.

inputs.description: No input -- this is a root asset that maintains local files.

outputs.description: No data output -- writes .mmdb files to database_directory and reports build metadata.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

editions.label: Editions
editions.description: MaxMind edition IDs to download and keep refreshed, e.g. 'GeoLite2-City', 'GeoLite2-Country', 'GeoLite2-ASN', or the paid 'GeoIP2-City' / 'GeoIP2-Country' / 'GeoIP2-ASN' / 'GeoIP2-ISP' equivalents -- your account_id/license_key must be entitled to each one requested. Each edition is written to '{database_directory}/{edition_id}.mmdb'.

database_directory.label: Database Directory
database_directory.description: Local directory the .mmdb files are written to and read from (created if missing).

account_id_env_var.label: Account Id Env Var
account_id_env_var.description: Environment variable holding your MaxMind account ID.

license_key_env_var.label: License Key Env Var
license_key_env_var.description: Environment variable holding your MaxMind license key.

host.label: Host
host.description: MaxMind GeoIP Update service host. Override only for testing against a mock server.

request_timeout_seconds.label: Request Timeout Seconds
request_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for each metadata/download HTTP request.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['python'] if not set.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 2,5' (the update check cadence).

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
description.label: Description

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

name: GeoIP Database Updater
